messages:
mika: Quick thread from the postmortem review 10: we keep seeing the same rollout failure pattern (regional cache invalidation + feature flags expanding too fast). Need a lightweight policy + owners to reduce recurrence. Propose: enforce cohort-aware rollouts, per-flag hard caps, deterministic auto-rollback, and re-ramp gating. Owners + small deliverables by next Wed?

drew: Agree on cohort-aware. Also recommend two classes of flags: critical (payments/auth) and non-critical. Critical flags get stricter defaults (max_exposure 10%, staged ramp small, mandatory canary).

ana: Slight tweak: require at least one business-impact metric (checkout_fail_rate or signup_drop) in rollback logic, otherwise 5xx-only noise triggers too many flips.

kevin: Practical rule: require any two signals in the same cohort over a 5m window OR single severe signal (5xx > 5%). That covers quiet but bad incidents and noisy small blips.

mika: Draft config (for rollout controller) to discuss in PR reviews:

```
flag: wallet_v3
class: critical
max_exposure_pct: 10
staged_ramp_pct: [1,5,20]
min_stage_minutes: 30
auto_rollback:
  strategy: "two_of_three"
  signals:
    - http_5xx_rate > 2.5% (5m)
    - checkout_fail_rate > 0.4% (5m)
    - canary_probe_fail_rate >= 1.0% (5m)
  severe_single_signal:
    - http_5xx_rate > 5% (5m)
re_ramp_gate: manual_if_rolled_back_within_4h
cohort_eval: true
simulate_endpoint: true
```

ana: Two implementation notes: (1) cohort_eval must reuse analytics cohort keys (region, user_tier). (2) simulate_endpoint is critical for reviewers to run historical windows during PRs.

drew: Action items concise: (1) mika own the policy doc + example matrix (owner: mika, ETA: 2025-10-01). (2) kevin implement severe_single_signal and two_of_three evaluation + unit tests in rollout-controller (owner: kevin, ETA: 2025-09-24). (3) ana add cohort aggregation and simulate_endpoint (owner: ana, ETA: 2025-09-22). I'll take post-rollout validation for the first 72h.

ops-bot: INC-2025-043 follow-ups updated: mika, kevin, ana. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

kevin: Acknowledged. Will also add a telemetry dashboard template and a "how to debug" note for oncall.

mika: Good. Let's do a short demo of simulate_endpoint in the PR so PMs and SRE can tune thresholds. Sync Friday 11am to review progress.
